overview_description.description:
Nomiku is a San Francisco-based startup born after one of the most successful Kickstarter projects in history for its inaugural Nomiku Immersion Circulator. 

Now shipping its second product--the smallest and most powerful sous vide device with a companion app--thousands of units can be found in homes and restaurants all over the world. 

Nomiku believes that everyone should be able to make the best food possible, every day of their lives. Everyone's a great cook, they just need the right tools.
